content.title: Optimize Billedes with PNG to WebP
content.p1: Want faster website load times? Konvertering your PNGs to WebP is the #1 recommendation from Google PageSpeed Insights.
content.p2: Vores værktøj compresses your PNG images into the modern WebP format, reducing file size by up to 30-50% while keeping the background transparent and the quality sharp.

why.title: Hvorfor WebP?
why.p1: WebP er et moderne billedformat udviklet af Google.
list: SEO Boost: Hurtigere websteder rangerer bedre på Google.
Mobilvenlig: Bruger mindre data til mobile besøgende.
Support: Understøttet by Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and all modern browsers.
